blocks.tamil_translation: you thought it a light matter - whereas with Allah it is (as a sin) grave. When you heard it, should you not have said, “It is not (fitting) for us to speak of this; (O Allah,) You are most pure; this is a grave slander”? Allah admonishes you that you must never return to anything like this, if you are believers.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يَشْهَدُوْنَ الزُّوْرَ لا وَاِذَا مَرُّوْا بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّواْ كِرَامًا۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And they are such that they do not bear false witness; and when they pass by what is vain, they pass by with dignity (keeping away from it).

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَاِذَا سَمِعُوا اللَّغْوَ اَعْرَضُوْا عَنْهُ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: When they hear what is vain, they turn away from it.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (يآيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ آمَنُوْا اِنْ جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ م بِنَبَاٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوْآ اَنْ تُصِيْبُوْا قَوْمًا م بِجَهَالَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوْا عَلي مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَادِمِيْنَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: O you who believe, if a wicked person brings you any news, verify it (by enquiring into it well); (for if you do not verify it in this way) you may harm a people out of ignorance - and then you will become regretful over what you have done.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (مَا يَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ اِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيْبٌ عَتِيْدٌ۞).
